spec.name: Reversal v23
spec.notes: High turnover by design: the reversal edge is measured net of 10 bps per unit of turnover.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 3.1, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 3%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's claimed performance is based on a single research period with no evidence of robustness or out-of-sample validation. The lack of a comprehensive backtest and the absence of any detailed analysis or data make it risky to deploy with real capital.
